adversarialClasses.probe: Valid local feed with deliberately invalid SHA-256 plus invalid-checksum unit cases
Release notes enter BuildPromptText, HTML tags are stripped/entities decoded, and ContentDialog receives plain text; no HTML control/script execution path or credential-like source text was found.
Actual local-feed decline made no full-package download; new decision cycles reset the latch and network/timeout failures map to retryable messages.
Fresh dated package directory, fresh TRX, feed metadata, manifest, and independent re-hashes were used; prior F4 artifacts were not used as pass evidence.
No product source, test source, workflow, or pre-existing evidence was deleted or changed by the verification; only fresh ignored evidence and final F4 records were written.
adversarialClasses.evidence: git status/diff inspection and final artifact paths

adversarialClasses.probe: Restore/build/test/package commands were bounded by 600000 ms; local hash/static/cleanup commands were bounded by 120000 ms; no external service was contacted.
The manifest hashes were independently recomputed with certutil; both matched Get-FileHash and feed metadata.

No forced process interruption was injected into ApplyUpdatesAndRestart because that operation intentionally was not run; failed download/checksum paths were exercised and preserved the current version.
LiveApp GUI/CDP tests are explicitly manual-gated and excluded from this bounded host-only/update run; no flaky pass was substituted.
